title: GenoAdjust: genome-scale protein function adjustment using constraint optimization
description: Source code, reproduction scripts and results for GenoAdjust, a post-hoc constraint optimization method that adjusts genome-scale protein function predictions so that they satisfy taxon constraints and complex coherence. This release contains the code and the results of the experiments reported in the revised manuscript.
